title: More detailed image-based communications with emotion (rockets, troop movements)

tellings.quote: >> Very like pictures, images. Yeah, these communications they were they were much more uh colorful.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US signals intelligence agency, trained him to talk to aliens with his mind, describes his work at a site he calls Base 2 in the early 1990s. He says the messages became much more colourful there, coming as pictures and images with emotion, showing things like rockets and troop movements. If true, it would mean the government ran a telepathic line to non-human beings.
